name: China Modern Dairy Holdings Ltd.
summary: China Modern Dairy Holdings Ltd., an investment holding company, operates dairy farming and produces raw milk in Mainland China, the United States, and internationally. It is involved in the production, trading, and sale of feeds; e-commerce platforms; forage grass planting; fertilizer treatment; and breeding of dairy cows. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Maanshan, the People's Republic of China. China Modern Dairy Holdings Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of China Mengniu Dairy Company Limited.
